## Release Notes

## Added

- Added Back Office Routine Database Checks on the Health tab.
  - Added a one-click **Run Routine Checks** action and a new check results panel.
  - Added a per-check summary and severity trend (ok/warning/critical).
  - Added local run details for slow query, index, dead-row, oversized column, and backup checks.

### Changed

- Back Office Health now includes operational routine checks that can be run on-demand for maintenance review and audit prep.

### Validation

- Changelog and `.github` release notes updated.
- Code compiles for modified JS/controllers/routes/views files.
- Ready for full staging validation and tagged release packaging.
